presentation.placement: shared feedback panel above the four stage tabs
presentation.default: automatically loop six illustrative phases while the panel is visible
presentation.visibility: suspend when hidden, offscreen or the workflow is inactive; resume on return
presentation.reduced_motion: start paused, allow explicit play; no flowing-particle animation
presentation.stage_selection: manual; animation never switches the selected stage or seeks a video

reference.adapted_pattern: phase highlights and moving edge indicators, with an independent pause control

scope: architecture illustration based on the existing server verify/feedback/cache rules; no live job dispatch or completed repair claim
